verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as GitHub's own CI/CD for running workflows in the repository. Hosted execution is only implied by the community mention of included Actions minutes. Nothing documents self-hosted/private runners, and one community comment asks for organization-level self-hosted runners as a missing feature. Missing for 10: documented platform-hosted runner details, documented self-hosted/private runner support, centralized runner/pipeline visibility across the organization, independent hands-on corroboration.
